protocol.scope: One three-image prompt, output 832×480, 124 frames at 24 FPS, seeds 0/1/2; 9 clips. This is a pilot, not a broad quality-equivalence study.
protocol.fixed: 1× PRO 5000, QAD checkpoint, CAKE attention, 36L decoder, DiT+encoder layerwise offload, same source files/prompt/seeds.
clip_descriptions: A young man with dark curly hair, a white T-shirt and silver wraparound sunglasses joins a family dinner in a warmly lit traditional Japanese room.
A young man wearing silver wraparound sunglasses with dark lenses.
protocol.reference_matching: Person and glasses: mean over sampled frames of the maximum cosine across a full frame plus nine fixed half-width/half-height windows. Scene: full-reference to full-frame cosine. Identical evaluator preprocessing for every policy; original references are always the evaluator inputs.
protocol.temporal: DINO adjacency is measured on the sampled frames. Optical flow and warp residual use all 123 adjacent frame pairs, downsampled to 208×120. Camera/object movement and occlusions affect these descriptive measures.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired differences aggregate each entire clip first. Two-sided 95% Student-t intervals use three seed-pair differences (df=2); frames are not independent samples. Intervals describe seed variation for this one prompt only.
protocol.adoption_rule: Prefer match only for a validated workload when reference detail, prompt/action completion, temporal quality and audio show no material regression. These uncalibrated proxies alone cannot pass that gate. No universal numeric margin or official VBench score is asserted.
limitations: DINO/CLIP are appearance/semantic proxies, not calibrated face-identity or small-detail recognizers.
Static frames do not verify action ordering, speech or lip synchronization.
Stability can reward static videos; always inspect motion and the original MP4.
Three seeds for one prompt cannot establish general non-inferiority.

metrics.reference_scene: DINOv2 full reference scene / full-frame cosine
metrics.motion_pixels: Mean optical flow magnitude (pixels at 208×120, descriptive)

decision.reason: One prompt and three paired seeds, uncalibrated visual proxies, changing motion/composition, and unscored action/audio details do not establish quality non-inferiority.

visual_review.scope: Assistant review of labeled fixed-frame contact sheets; not a human blind panel or full-motion/audio evaluation.
visual_review.summary: In the inspected frames, all three policies retain the broad setup: a curly-haired man in a white T-shirt, sunglasses and a warm family-dinner scene. Composition, character positions and sunglasses timing vary. For seed 0, match places another diner in front of the main subject at the end, while native keeps the subject more exposed. These samples do not establish unchanged fine facial/product details, action order, speech or lip sync.
visual_review.adoption: Quality equivalence is not established. Keep match as an explicitly selected performance candidate; retain native-size references as the quality control until representative workload review passes.
